input.quote: 10.1 On expiry or termination, Customer's right to access terminated subscription Services ends after any agreed transition period. Rights in accepted Deliverables, paid-up licences, Customer Data, and materials Customer owned or licensed independently continue according to their terms.
input.rationale: Section 10 (Effect of Expiry or Termination) contains no exit obligations for us: 10.1 merely ends access "after any agreed transition period" (no committed assistance duration or rates), and 10.2 covers only Deliverables and refunds. Section 15 governs processing but imposes no return, export, or deletion duty, and 16.5's return/destroy obligation is limited to Confidential Information and expressly refers Customer Data out to Sections 11 and 15 (Section 11 does not exist in the Agreement). The Agreement therefore fails even the fallback (90 days' assistance; export within 30 days) and risks the walk-away outcome of no data return. We insert a single clause at the preferred position: six months' transition assistance at then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days of expiry or termination, and certified deletion after that return.

proposal.summary: Insert a transition-assistance and data-return clause in Section 10
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 10 ends the Services without any exit help or data return, so we add a short clause: up to six months of transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion after that return. We can fall back to 90 days of assistance with export within 30 days.

ops.text: On expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall (a) at Customer's request, provide transition assistance for up to six months after that expiry or termination at Vendor's then-current rates; (b) within thirty days after that expiry or termination, return all Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format; and (c) after that return, delete Customer Data from its systems and certify the deletion in writing.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
